title: YAWYE - You are what you eat
description: Mod that gives beneficial status effects applied when eating food. Different food has different effects.
body:
# YAWYE -- You Are What You Eat

## A server side fabric mod that gives beneficial effects when eating different types of food.

A very simple implementation of a mod idea I heard on youtube shorts.

- Cooked beef for resistence
- Cooked fish for water-breathing and dolphins grace
- Baked potatoes for faster mining
- and many more 

This mod also gives a few risk/reward trade-offs

- Eating raw meat will now have a chance of giving you nausia and poisoning
- Zombie flesh will now give you strength with a garunteed side effect of poison (along side vanilla hunger)

Overall, this mod is very simple (it could be a single function.) All the mod does is inject some logic at the end of minecrafts vanilla finish using logic using a mixin.
